lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Mercedes, Jorge here. How's your Tuesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about fruit at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How have you been feeling since we last talked?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've had more energy, I noticed that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's great to hear.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the walking went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, not much. Between appointments and everything, there was no time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already bought new sneakers. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, if I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the walking going forward?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really. I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: When I walk I sleep better, I noticed that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the walking. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already bought new sneakers.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Next week I want you to walk 20 minutes on 5 days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 9.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 9 and not a 6?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 0 out of 5 days, the hard part was finding the time, and next week you're going to walk 20 minutes on 5 days. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Mercedes, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

flags.reason: Coach set a 20-min, 5-day goal right after participant said 'Not yet' to 5 days, without asking permission or collaborating.
Participant's fruit-at-night question was never addressed or revisited.
Participant's fear of ending up like her dad was not explored; coach moved on.
Repeats 'You know your schedule better than anyone' verbatim from line 33, sounding scripted.

score.summary: Jorge checked in, reviewed the walking goal, and closed with a clear summary and next contact. However, he set the 5-day goal directly after Mercedes said she wasn't ready, and he dropped her fruit question and her fear about her dad, which weakened partnership.
strengths: Line 22: affirmed persistence on a hard week, 'That says a lot about you.'
Line 24: asked an open question about why this matters to her, drawing out change talk.
Line 55: concise summary that invited correction, and it was accepted.
coaching_tips: Line 49: after 'Not yet' at line 13, ask permission or offer options before setting the 20-minute, 5-day goal.
Line 4: return to the fruit-at-night question or ask whether she wants to set it aside.
Line 11: explore 'I don't want to end up like my dad' with an open question before moving on.
Line 41: vary reflections instead of repeating the line from 33.
